formula: let score = 0; let lawCount = 0; const revenueMultiplier = {under1m: 0.5, '1m-10m': 1, '10m-25m': 1.5, '25m-100m': 2, over100m: 2.5}[annualRevenue] || 1; const dataMultiplier = {under10k: 0.5, '10k-100k': 1, '100k-500k': 1.5, '500k-1m': 2, over1m: 2.5}[dataVolume] || 1; const stateMultiplier = {'single-state': 0.8, 'multi-state': 1.2, nationwide: 1.8, international: 2}[operatingStates] || 1; const businessRisk = {ecommerce: 15, saas: 20, healthcare: 25, finance: 25, education: 10, nonprofit: 5, other: 15}[businessType] || 15; score = businessRisk * revenueMultiplier * dataMultiplier * stateMultiplier; if (sensitiveData) score *= 1.4; if (dataSales) score *= 1.3; if (dataVolume === 'over1m' || annualRevenue === 'over100m') lawCount = 8; else if (dataVolume === '100k-500k' || annualRevenue === '25m-100m') lawCount = 5; else if (dataVolume === '10k-100k' || annualRevenue === '10m-25m') lawCount = 3; else lawCount = 1; score = Math.min(100, Math.round(score)); const level = score >= 80 ? 'HIGH': score >= 60 ? 'MEDIUM-HIGH': score >= 40 ? 'MEDIUM': score >= 20 ? 'LOW-MEDIUM': 'LOW'; return {riskScore: score, riskLevel: level, applicableLaws: lawCount};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your privacy law compliance risk by analyzing business characteristics against state privacy law requirements. Factors include revenue thresholds, data processing volume, business type, geographic scope, and data handling practices. The assessment covers major state privacy laws including CCPA, VCDPA, CPA, Texas DPRA, and others.
tips: Revenue and data volume thresholds are key triggers for most state privacy laws - California requires $25M revenue OR 100k+ consumers, Virginia requires 100k+ consumers OR 25k+ sold records
Use a privacy-focused browser to research state privacy law requirements privately without being tracked by legal research platforms
Businesses processing sensitive personal data (health, financial, biometric) face higher compliance requirements and penalties across most state laws
Multi-state operations significantly increase complexity as each state has different requirements, timelines, and enforcement mechanisms

interpretation.label: MEDIUM-HIGH RISK

interpretation.label: HIGH RISK
